meta.name: ai-search-hub
meta.description: Run the AI Search Hub browser automation scripts for Yuanbao, LongCat, Doubao, Qwen, Gemini, Grok, and MiniMax. Use this skill when the user wants to ask one of those sites a prompt, auto-start or attach to a Chrome DevTools session on port 9222, seed an isolated debug browser profile from the user's local browser data, detect whether login is required, wait for the user to finish logging in if needed, and then continue automatically.

copy.tagline: 自动向多个AI搜索网站提交提示词并处理登录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要同时向多个AI搜索网站提问并自动处理登录流程
copy.tagline_en: Automate prompt submission to multiple AI search sites with login handling
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to submit prompts to multiple AI search sites and handle login automatically

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以自动打开浏览器，登录指定 AI 网站（如元宝、龙猫、豆包、通义千问、Gemini、Grok、MiniMax），输入你的问题并获取回答。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 向这些 AI 网站提问，或需要自动操作浏览器登录并提交问题时触发。

say.text: 用豆包帮我查一下杭州美食攻略。
say.note: Claude 会打开豆包网站，登录后输入问题并返回结果。

say.text: 用 Gemini 搜索最新的 AI 新闻。
用元宝查一下微信公众号里的热门文章。
say.note: Claude 会打开元宝网站，登录后搜索相关内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically open a browser, log in to specified AI websites (Yuanbao, LongCat, Doubao, Qwen, Gemini, Grok, MiniMax), enter your question, and retrieve the answer.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to query one of these AI websites or need automated browser login and submission.

say_en.text: Use Doubao to find a Hangzhou food guide.
say_en.note: Claude will open Doubao, log in, enter the prompt, and return results.

say_en.text: Use Gemini to search for latest AI news.
say_en.note: Claude will open Gemini, enter the prompt, and wait for a reply.

say_en.text: Use Yuanbao to find popular articles from WeChat public accounts.
say_en.note: Claude will open Yuanbao, log in, and search for content.
